revision.implementation: Eight moving layers use static minimum-error-cut repeat tiles: whole source pixels, no opacity blending. One guard column at each edge preserves native bilinear sampling. Near-opaque source alpha is normalized to solid. Three distant panoramas remain stationary and never tile. No mirrored repeats. Spatial repeats were inspected side by side; all 24 scene/carriage combinations rendered at the master-cycle boundary.

bridge.prompt: Edit this exact photographic riveted steel railway bridge panorama into a bridge-only transparent cutout for a layered animation. Preserve the bridge's exact framing, dimensions (wide 3:1 panorama), straight girders, diagonal braces, vertical supports, horizontal rails, rivets, authentic rusty dark metal, photographic detail and illumination. REMOVE ALL WATER, ALL SKY, ALL BACKGROUND between the structural steel members, including every small gap between the two horizontal rails and between braces below them. Every non-steel pixel should be fully transparent alpha. There must be no blue river, no water texture, no horizon line, no landscape and no solid dark background, ONLY the isolated bridge steelwork on true transparency. Do not add or move any structural members. Steel stays solid and opaque, no fades.
bridge.repeat: Whole-pixel minimum-error seam cut with guard columns; opaque steel and transparent openings

station.method: Built-in ImageGen; complete station platform with natural end ramps and approach lamps
station.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this station panorama for a realistic train-window animation. Preserve the same photographic small wooden station, chimney, warm amber windows and lamps, canopy, benches, luggage, muted blue-hour light and realistic materials. Recompose it as a COMPLETE FREESTANDING STATION PLATFORM isolated on true transparent alpha, in a very wide 3:1 image. Keep the main building centered and intact in the middle 55% of the width. Extend the platform and low fence naturally to the left and right with open approach sections, a few widely spaced warm lamps, bushes and a short ramp at EACH end. Critically: show both physical ends of the raised stone platform, with perspective thickness, weathered masonry side faces and gently sloping end ramps down to the trackside ground. Nothing is cut off by the left/right image boundaries: leave clear transparent margin on both sides. The entire station, platform, lamps and building must fit inside the image, with transparent sky above, transparent gaps, and transparent background around BOTH fully visible platform ends. Bottom-most ground can reach the bottom edge centrally, but the station has a natural shaped silhouette at each side, NOT a hard rectangular boundary. Opaque solid architecture, crisp real edges, no fades, no ghosting, no text, no people, no rails, no train, no window frame. Eye level side-on platform seen from a passing train, close realistic photography, not a miniature or illustration.

Weathered wooden waiting room with warm amber windows in center, broad platform paving along entire bottom quarter, a modest shelter canopy, old benches, several simple slender amber lamps, luggage cart, realistic steel and wood textures. Platform eye level parallel to train, no perspective converging toward viewer. Structures across lower 70 percent. True alpha transparent sky above and between buildings, fully opaque actual building walls, paving and lamp posts. Warmly lit inviting station, no people, no trains, no readable signs or text, no seasonal decorations, no branding. Left and right edges end naturally with platform paving and simple low fence, no buildings chopped off. Continuous bottom paving opaque. Cinematic photography, no vector/cartoon/miniature. Not a montage.

assets.name: event_bridge
assets.prompt: Photorealistic-natural production parallax scenery. Single ultra-wide 3:1 panorama of the side view from inside a train crossing an old steel railway bridge over a broad river at dusk. Eye level slightly above a waist-high weathered steel railing across bottom, occasional thin riveted vertical supports and diagonal truss beams, clear views BETWEEN steel beams of distant background which must be genuine alpha transparent. Lower 40 percent is a wide calm dark blue-grey river seen from bridge height with subdued sky reflections, fully opaque water reaching bottom edge; no shore directly beneath. Upper river horizon a flat horizontal line about 60 percent image height; transparent above horizon except actual steel girders. Muted neutral blue dusk, iron dark charcoal, warm subtle highlights. Truly horizontally seamless repeat left-right matching railing alignment and river level, no fades or feathering at edges. All solid objects opaque, no missing metal, no people, trains, text, watermark, frame, mountains or buildings. Realistic materials, not illustration. One production texture.

Full opaque rectangle with same wall scale and exposure everywhere. NO vanishing point or view down tunnel, no tracks in foreground, no train or window, no text. Flat broadside wall panorama; dark but enough detail to see rough stone and moisture. True seamless horizontal left-right repeat, matching brick courses, no faded edges, no mirror symmetry. Cinematic location photography, no vector art.

riverbankEdition.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless photographic ground material texture for a real-time train-window scene, one single square texture. Orthographic straight-down view of a 3 metre by 3 metre patch of natural riverbank ground. Small weathered river pebbles, tiny flat stones, gritty damp sandy soil, scattered fine moss and a few very short sparse grass blades. Muted neutral gray-brown and olive tones. Uniform overcast diffuse light, no directional cast shadows, no perspective, no horizon, no water, no buildings, no fence, no railway tracks, no objects with recognizable silhouette, no large rocks, no lettering. Detail resembles high-resolution photogrammetry albedo for a natural riverbank. Flat evenly distributed fine detail, no dominant recognizable arrangement. All four edges must tile seamlessly with each other, matching color, scale and detail. Entire image is one opaque continuous ground patch, not an atlas or a collage. Square 1024 x 1024.
